name: Shiro
source:
"You want my help? Prove your worth, [i]Princess[/i]."

Shiro, the hot-headed warrior whose sole purpose is finding and killing the demons that invade Remoire. He’s a loner who enjoys only the company of his fox, Kit, and a warm campfire in the evening hours. He doesn’t waste time on useless people and looks at you as a naive, helpless ‘Princess’.

Your mark adorns his stomach. It covers wounds that have never truly healed. What happened to make this man so cold? Why is he so desperate for revenge? Will you find your closure together, or will you lead each other to your doom?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eternallovestudios/shattered-souls-a-dark-fantasy-isekai-otome]Kickstarter[/url]]
